cells.concern: Valid successful retrieval with selected evidence
exactAssertions: At least one raw hit is returned.
At least one eligible item is selected under the frozen policy.

cells.concern: No raw vector hits
exactAssertions: Raw hit count is zero.
Selected evidence count is zero.

cells.concern: All raw hits are below the inclusive minimum score
exactAssertions: Every raw score is strictly below 0.25.
Selected evidence count is zero.

cells.concern: Scalar budget excludes every otherwise selectable item
exactAssertions: Every eligible score is at least 0.25.
The 16000-scalar aggregate budget excludes all selected evidence.

cells.concern: Query dimension is incompatible with the generation
exactAssertions: Failure occurs before ranking.
No result sequence is emitted.

cells.concern: Query contains a non-finite component
exactAssertions: NaN and infinity are rejected.
No result sequence is emitted.

cells.concern: Query has zero magnitude
exactAssertions: Zero query magnitude is rejected.
No cosine quotient is produced.

cells.concern: Stored vector contains a non-finite component
exactAssertions: The invalid stored component is fail-closed.
No scored result is emitted.

cells.concern: Stored vector norm is non-finite
exactAssertions: The invalid stored norm is fail-closed.
No scored result is emitted.

cells.concern: Numeric intermediate is non-finite
exactAssertions: Any non-finite dot-product or norm intermediate is rejected.
No scored result is emitted.

cells.concern: Cosine quotient is non-finite
exactAssertions: The non-finite quotient is rejected before canonicalisation.
No scored result is emitted.

cells.concern: Positive cosine boundary canonicalises to exact positive one
exactAssertions: The finite internal quotient at the positive boundary is canonicalised to exact +1.
The returned float64 score bits equal 0x3ff0000000000000.

cells.concern: Negative cosine boundary canonicalises to exact negative one
exactAssertions: The finite internal quotient at the negative boundary is canonicalised to exact -1.
The returned float64 score bits equal 0xbff0000000000000.

cells.concern: First representable internal value below positive one is preserved
exactAssertions: The finite value immediately inside +1 is not clamped.
Its float64 score bits are preserved exactly.

cells.concern: First representable external value above positive one canonicalises
exactAssertions: The finite value immediately outside +1 is canonicalised to +1.
The returned float64 score bits equal 0x3ff0000000000000.

cells.concern: First representable internal value above negative one is preserved
exactAssertions: The finite value immediately inside -1 is not clamped.
Its float64 score bits are preserved exactly.

cells.concern: First representable external value below negative one canonicalises
exactAssertions: The finite value immediately outside -1 is canonicalised to -1.
The returned float64 score bits equal 0xbff0000000000000.

cells.concern: Constructible internal positive zero is preserved
exactAssertions: The returned score remains +0.
Its float64 score bits equal 0x0000000000000000.

cells.concern: Constructible internal negative zero remains digest-distinct
exactAssertions: The returned score remains -0.
Its float64 score bits equal 0x8000000000000000 and differ from +0 in the digest.

cells.concern: Stored zero vector produces exact positive zero score
exactAssertions: A valid stored zero vector produces exact +0 under the accepted numerical semantics.
The returned float64 score bits equal 0x0000000000000000.

cells.concern: Requested generation is absent
exactAssertions: No fallback generation is selected.
No result sequence is emitted.

cells.concern: Requested generation is not validated
exactAssertions: The unvalidated generation is not queried.
No result sequence is emitted.

cells.concern: Retrieval v1 and retrieval v2 descriptor or compatibility key mismatch
exactAssertions: No compatibility fallback is allowed.
The /2 descriptor and retrieval-v2 compatibility identity remain mandatory.

cells.concern: Duplicate global chunk ordinal
exactAssertions: Duplicate ordinals fail closed.
No ambiguous total order is emitted.

cells.concern: Negative global chunk ordinal
exactAssertions: Negative ordinals fail closed.
No result sequence is emitted.

cells.concern: Returned hit identity is incompatible with the bound generation
exactAssertions: Every hit identity must resolve within the frozen eligible binding set.
An incompatible hit is never selected.

cells.concern: Declared and actual result counts differ
exactAssertions: Raw and selected counts exactly match their sequences.
Count mismatch fails the entire result.

cells.concern: Composite result ordering is incompatible
exactAssertions: Results are ordered by Score DESC then global ChunkOrdinal ASC.
Any incompatible order fails the entire result.

cells.concern: Required retrieval configuration is absent
exactAssertions: No implicit configuration value is substituted.
No retrieval is attempted.

cells.concern: Frozen versions, limits, or descriptor are internally inconsistent
exactAssertions: All frozen identities and limits must agree before retrieval.
No retrieval is attempted.

cells.concern: Operation cancellation
exactAssertions: Cancellation remains distinguishable from failure.
No partial result is accepted.

cells.concern: Injected unclassified failure
exactAssertions: The failure is sanitised and typed.
No partial result is accepted.

cells.concern: Nine adversarial candidates exercise top-k eight and total ordering
exactAssertions: Exactly the first eight candidates under the frozen total order are raw hits.
Ties are resolved globally by ChunkOrdinal ASC.

cells.concern: Write permutations, replay, and reopen retain one canonical digest
exactAssertions: All planned storage permutations produce the same ordered result digest.
Replay and reopen produce the same ordered result digest.

cells.concern: Adapter returns a NaN score
exactAssertions: A returned NaN score violates the Application contract.
No canonical result is emitted.

cells.concern: Adapter returns an infinite score
exactAssertions: A returned infinite score violates the Application contract.
No canonical result is emitted.

cells.concern: Adapter returns a score above positive one
exactAssertions: An adapter-returned score above +1 is not canonicalised by Application.
The contract violation fails closed.

cells.concern: Adapter returns a score below negative one
exactAssertions: An adapter-returned score below -1 is not canonicalised by Application.
The contract violation fails closed.
